name: Al-Abbas ibn al-Ahnaf
bio: Abu al-Fadl al-Abbas ibn al-Ahnaf grew up in Baghdad. His family traced its origins to al-Yamama in central Arabia and had ties to Basra. He devoted his verse to love, often addressing a woman he calls Fawz. Al-Zajjaji records his poems being read and argued over at court. Al-Zirikli dates his death to 192 AH (808 CE) and records both Baghdad and Basra as places given for it.
